candidates.title: Global skin gene expression profile of early diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis shows a prominent innate and adaptive immunity profile
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing

criteria.detail: tissue ['skin biopsy']; 48 SSc / 33 HC after one-sample-per-subject (floor 20 per arm)
per-sample condition labels present in the series matrix

not contradicted (residual risk declared): PRESS registry, multicentre; the PMID 31767698 author list includes the University of Pittsburgh (affiliation 19), the centre of Tabib 2021 (GSE138669). Tabib 2021 (PMID 34282151) recruited 12 SSc / 10 HC under the UPMC IRB and does not mention PRESS. No public record links any GSE130955 donor to a single-cell dataset; overlap is neither shown nor excludable. At most the 12 Tabib SSc donors could be shared with the 48 PRESS SSc donors.
not found in the curated layer, curation docs or manuscript

candidates.donor_overlap_decision: retained with the residual risk declared (curator decision 2026-11-09); carried into the Analysis A limitations

expression.kind: RNA-seq FPKM per sample (Ensembl gene IDs) in GSE130955_RAW.tar
expression.normalisation: log2(FPKM + 1); raw counts are not deposited, so TMM/vst is not available (singscore is rank-based and unaffected; the z-score sensitivity sees log2 FPKM)

frozen_rule: the verified list is frozen: a cohort may not be dropped after its result is known

symbol_resolution.rule: map symbols and platform symbols are both resolved to current approved HGNC symbols (unique previous-symbol successor) before matching; curated overrides first

override_reason.TAZ: the map's TAZ is the YAP co-activator (WWTR1); HGNC previous symbol TAZ is TAFAZZIN, an unrelated gene
